name: AgeTech After Dark @ CES 2027 (pitch route into AgeTech Collaborative from AARP Accelerator)
geo: National; pitch event in Las Vegas, NV on 2027-01-07
gives: 3-minute live pitch to industry panel; finalists get a free CES 2027 ticket; winner gets $10,000 prize; AgeTech Collaborative accelerator (8 weeks, invitation-only) sources startups through these pitch events
cost: Free to apply; no equity stated. Travel to Las Vegas at own cost.
deadline: 2026-10-12 11:59 pm (applications opened 2026-09-01). Listing header still says 'CES 2026', so confirm on the page.
why: Welcomes healthspan and wellness; prototypes welcome but prefers market-ready products. Vybe launches May 2027. Deadline is tomorrow.
apply: agetechcollaborative.org, AgeTech After Dark event page

name: SBA Boots to Business Reboot (online, live Zoom)
org: U.S. Small Business Administration (Mississippi District Office session)
geo: Online; this session is aimed at service members/spouses in AL, AZ, LA, MS
gives: Two-day entrepreneurship course; completers can take further B2B online courses at no cost
cost: Free for service members, veterans and military spouses; no equity
deadline: Session 2026-10-27 (register via SBA VETS portal; Zoom link sent about a week before). Other sessions are scheduled locally.
why: Veteran founder is eligible and it is free, but it is intro-level training and this session targets other states.
apply: Register through the SBA VETS portal; event listing at legacy.sba.gov/event/87448. Ask the NC Veterans Business Outreach Center or NCMBC for NC sessions.

name: Techstars AI Health Baltimore (Spring 2027)
org: Techstars (backers include Johns Hopkins and Maryland health systems)
gives: $220,000 investment, mentorship, 13-week program from 2027-03-08 to Demo Day 2027-06-03, Techstars network
cost: EQUITY: $200,000 uncapped MFN SAFE plus $20,000 for equity under a post-money convertible equity agreement
deadline: 2026-11-18 (opened 2026-08-24; later applications go to a general pool)
why: East Coast health cohort for AI in healthcare; Vybe's overnight ECG/HRV analytics plus SDK qualifies. Equity required. Timing fits May 2027 launch.
apply: techstars.com/accelerators, choose AI Health Baltimore, apply before 2026-11-18

name: NC SBTDC business counseling
org: Small Business and Technology Development Center (UNC System)
geo: North Carolina; 16 regional offices including the Triangle
gives: Confidential one-on-one counseling at no cost (50,000+ hours to 5,500+ businesses in 2025); capital-readiness help through the SSBCI Technical Assistance Program; veteran 'Taking the Leap' cohort ran in Raleigh in 2025
deadline: Rolling (2026 source: SBTDC 'State of Small Business in 2026')
why: Raleigh-based, free, available now; helps with capital readiness and planning before the May 2027 launch.
apply: sbtdc.org: request counseling with the Raleigh-area office

name: AWS Activate Founders
gives: $1,000 in AWS credits, up to $5,000 for select participants; Activate resources
cost: Free; no equity. Requires an AWS account on a paid-tier plan.
deadline: Rolling; reply in 5-10 business days (2026 source: Causo 'How to Apply for AWS Activate Credits in 2026')
why: Self-funded and pre-Series B fits. Credits cover the SDK backend and data pipeline.
apply: Create an AWS Builder ID and apply at aws.amazon.com/activate (Founders tier). Needs a business email and working website.

name: Google for Startups Cloud Program - Start tier
gives: $2,000 in Google Cloud credits, resources and support
deadline: Rolling (Google startup pages current as of 2026; Google/Antler 2026 PDF)
why: For tech startups with no institutional funding yet, which fits Vybe. Google pages disagree on founding age (5 years vs 24 months).

name: Microsoft for Startups (self-service track)
gives: $1,000 Azure credits (90 days), up to $5,000 total after business verification (180 days); Investor Network track ($100K+) needs an affiliated investor
deadline: Rolling (2026 sources: Ukrainian Startup Fund notice dated 2026-07-03; fin.ai 'Startup Programs Compared 2026')
why: Free and eligible, but credits expire quickly and overlap with AWS/Google. Take only if Azure is the chosen stack.
apply: microsoft.com/startups (Founders Hub sign-up, then business verification)

name: NVIDIA Inception
gives: Free self-paced Deep Learning Institute credits, SDKs, hardware/software discounts, partner offers, investor connections, go-to-market support; cloud credits up to $100K are separately gated
deadline: Rolling (2026 source: Causo 'How to Apply to NVIDIA Inception in 2026')
why: Needs incorporation, website, employed developer and an AI/data science product; useful only if Vybe's HRV models are central.
apply: nvidia.com/startups (Inception application with company website and developer + executive contacts)

name: Plug and Play accelerator (Health vertical)
geo: Multiple US hubs (e.g., Orlando health program); varies by batch
gives: Matching with corporate partners, Playbook invitation, potential corporate pilots
cost: Equity-free; no fees or commissions reported
deadline: Rolling, per batch (2026 source: Causo 'How to Apply to Plug and Play Accelerator in 2026'); no current Health batch date found
why: Equity-free path to health-system and corporate pilots, but no open Health batch date confirmed.
apply: plugandplaytechcenter.com: pick the Health vertical/location batch and apply on that page

name: HAX (SOSV) hardware accelerator
gives: Investment (reported up to $550K in 2025-26 sources; older sources say $250K), 35,000 sq ft hardware labs, engineering support
cost: EQUITY: SOSV pre-seed terms (older reports: ~9-10%). One listing says it charges a fee; this is unverified.
deadline: Rolling; reportedly 2-3 teams admitted per month (2026 sources: Peony 'Hardware Accelerators in 2026', Causo HAX 2026 guide)
why: Hardware-only and wants a working prototype, which the DevKit provides; requires equity and Newark residency.

name: SBA VetCert (VOSB/SDVOSB certification)
gives: Veteran-owned small business certification for federal set-aside and sole-source contracts (VA for VOSB; government-wide for SDVOSB)
cost: No fee found in sources (SBA says most of its services are free; confirm). No equity.
deadline: Rolling; average processing about 12 days reported (2026 sources: beancount.io guide 2026-09-01; disabledveterans.org 2026)
why: Needs 51% veteran ownership and SAM.gov registration; matters mainly for federal/VA sales, not the consumer launch.
